sum: Avalanche Treasury Corporation operates as a digital asset treasury company that provides investors with exposure to the Avalanche ecosystem as businesses move on-chain. The company provides access to Avalanche, a blockchain technology platform that offers flexibility, interoperability, and speed without requiring investors to directly hold digital assets. It caters to enterprises, financial institutions, consumer applications, and governments. The company was founded in 2025 and is based in New York, New York. Avalanche Treasury Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Avalanche Foundation.
ceo: Mr. Gerald Bartholomew Smith (CEO, President & Chairman)
